remarks:
Move in Ready! If you are looking to downsize to a one-floor home and have others handle your snow removal and lawn care, Marrano's Mission Hills is where you want to be! This "Patio A" features Luxury Vinyl Plank floors throughout the entire home, a fireplace, a tray ceiling in the living room/dining room combo and a kitchen with white cabinetry, ceramic tile backsplash and gorgeous quartz countertops. Primary bedroom with a step ceiling and spacious WIC. Primary bath features a ceramic tile walk-in shower. Beautiful plumbing and lighting fixtures. First floor laundry, 2 car garage, cement driveway, front landscaping and sprinklers system included! For more info and current incentive stop by our model at 4543 Camp Rd #208 open daily 1-5pm.
See also ML#B1716582.
